name: PDF Tools MCP Server
description: A comprehensive tool server for reading, merging, and extracting content from PDF files via local paths or direct URLs. It enables metadata retrieval, regex searching, and page-specific text extraction with built-in caching and workspace-restricted security.

rawRecord.description: A comprehensive tool server for reading, merging, and extracting content from PDF files via local paths or direct URLs. It enables metadata retrieval, regex searching, and page-specific text extraction with built-in caching and workspace-restricted security.

tempfile_dir.description: The directory for temporary files used for URL support. PDFs from URLs are downloaded here. Default is ~/.pdf_tools_temp

workspace_path.description: The directory the tool can access. For security reasons, this tool can only access files within the specified workspace directory and cannot access files outside the workspace directory.
